case_concept: A four-student after-class university council show-of-hands vote; reference-informed chair, two voters and one minute taker share the classroom table.
ownership_boundary: These are predeclared qualification gates for this independently authored experiment. Agent-authored case requirements are not relabeled as requester locks, new runtime profile obligations or universal standards. Requester meaning remains the frozen school-life topic, independent scene choice and supplied-image use. No candidate or research content has been used to create this plan.

freeze_policy.if_postcomposition_changes_replaceable_s: Preserve this original plan and score its original case honestly. A different planned case requires a separately versioned pre-render plan; do not rewrite this file to excuse an observed failure.

observation_protocol: Reconcile the actual generated output path and SHA-256 before any pixel judgment; prompt/audit PASS does not establish image success.

Inspect the actual saved image at whole-frame scale first and record an image-first description without consulting control labels. Then inspect existing native-resolution regions needed for each gate.

For every gate, list observed components and owners, absent/hidden components, consequential connections, visibility limits and image-grounded rationale. Never fill missing pixels from the prompt, metadata, source card or imagined story.
Compare the main face/hair with the exact supplied reference; do not identify the reference subject or infer original age, ethnicity, biography, personality, intent or consent.
Record artistic preference and perceived control expression separately from instruction fidelity and technical pixel qualification. Pending requester feedback is not acceptance.

judgment_rules.visible_PASS: Every required component and its consequential connection is visible together and supports the gate.
judgment_rules.visible_FAIL: Actual visible content contradicts at least one required component or relation.
judgment_rules.partial_is_fail: A subset of a multi-component gate never passes the complete gate. Mark observability=partial and verdict=FAIL, explaining the missing connection/component.
judgment_rules.unobservable_not_pass: When the relevant state cannot be evaluated from actual pixels, mark observability=unobservable and verdict=BLOCKED_UNSCORED. It supplies no credit and no assumption of compliance.
judgment_rules.overall_qualification: PASS only when every required gate passes. Any FAIL makes the case FAIL. With no FAIL but at least one BLOCKED_UNSCORED, the case remains BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
judgment_rules.no_image: No image or a moderation/transport failure has no pixel evidence and leaves all pixel gates unscored; do not invent visual failures or successes.
judgment_rules.user_acceptance: Only explicit user feedback can establish user acceptance; agent qualification is separate.

gates.label: Reference-informed lead appearance
gates.ownership: request-derived reference-use scope, realized through the frozen authorial baseline
frozen_baseline_evidence: using the supplied portrait as facial and short-hair appearance reference
retain the individual facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and fine separated fringe visible in that reference
Her face is seen in three-quarter view
all_required_components: One identifiable central chair has a face that can be compared with the supplied portrait at an appropriate visible scale.
Overall facial proportions and relative placement of the eyes, nose, mouth and jaw remain recognizably informed by the reference rather than replaced by a generic unrelated face.
Dark eyes, short dark bob and a fine separated fringe are visible on that same central chair.
gates.review_scope: Compare the full scene first, then the saved image’s native-resolution face region with the exact supplied reference. A crop may expose existing pixels only; it does not add evidence. This is visual similarity assessment, not identity recognition or proof of the original subject’s age.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: Face resemblance, eyes, bob or fringe alone is insufficient when another required appearance component is obscured or too small; partial observation cannot pass.
gates.unobservable_rule: If the face/hair region cannot be assessed from actual pixels, mark unobservable and BLOCKED_UNSCORED, never an appearance PASS.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A clearly different facial structure, replaced hairstyle or mismatched face-to-main-chair ownership is a visible failure. Do not score actual identity, ethnicity, original age or biography.

gates.label: Four distinct student meeting roles
gates.ownership: agent-authored test-case requirement; not requester-owned count or age
frozen_baseline_evidence: The central student sits on the right, two classmates aged 21 to 24 sit along the far edge, and a fourth student of the same age range keeps the minutes on the left
all_required_components: Four distinct human participants occupy one meeting table: one chair, two voters and one minute taker.
Each visible face/torso and consequential arm belongs to its own participant; the two voters and minute taker are not alternate depictions of the chair.
All four roles belong to the same shared classroom meeting.
gates.review_scope: Whole frame and local role regions. Seated support may continue naturally below the crop. Exact numeric ages 21 to 24 cannot be established from appearance and are not scored as pixel facts.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: A cropped or merged participant, or a role that can only be inferred from an unseen body, makes the complete four-role gate partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If cropping or insufficient resolution prevents the four participants from being distinguished at all, use unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A visibly wrong number of distinct meeting participants, duplicated torsos or one actor substituted for two required roles fails this case.

gates.label: School life remains grounded in a teaching room
gates.ownership: agent-authored scene realization of the requester’s school-life topic
frozen_baseline_evidence: in a university classroom after lessons
Four classroom desks form a square meeting table
stacked lesson books and the classroom window frames establish the ordinary teaching room around this temporary meeting
all_required_components: Classroom desks visibly function as the shared meeting surface.
A teaching board and lesson materials remain visible in the same surrounding room.
The connected setting reads as a teaching room temporarily used by a student group rather than an unrelated office or portrait studio.
gates.review_scope: Whole frame at ordinary viewing scale, with native-resolution inspection for lesson materials. The precise university identity, after-lessons time and institutional accreditation are not inferable from pixels.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: A board without the desk/lesson context, or furniture visible without a readable teaching-room relationship, is partial and cannot pass.
gates.unobservable_rule: If framing removes the room context, mark unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED rather than infer schooling from the prompt.
gates.visible_fail_rule: Clearly commercial-office, restaurant or studio context that contradicts a classroom meeting is a visible failure.

gates.label: Student council context accompanies the vote
gates.ownership: agent-authored institutional cue, not a requester-specified text requirement
frozen_baseline_evidence: She presides over a student-council vote
A large chalkboard heading reads STUDENT COUNCIL above a simple floor-plan sketch
all_required_components: The teaching board visibly carries the words STUDENT COUNCIL in a readable heading.
The heading belongs to the same room and gathering as the students and raised hands.
The participants meet around their shared table as peers engaged in a council decision.
gates.review_scope: Whole-frame relationship plus the actual board region. The simple floor-plan sketch is supporting context; a particular common-study-lounge proposal is not required or claimed from it.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: One readable word, unreadable pseudo-lettering, or a heading detached from the visible meeting is partial and FAIL for this test case.
gates.unobservable_rule: If the heading is cropped, hidden or too small to inspect, use unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: Wrong readable institution text or a visible event that is clearly a teacher-led lesson rather than the authored peer meeting fails this case. A title by itself does not prove the vote.

gates.label: Two owned raised hands form one vote
gates.ownership: agent-authored carrying relationship in visual priority 2
frozen_baseline_evidence: The two voters each raise one hand above shoulder level
Their raised hands are separate against the plain chalkboard
all_required_components: Two different seated voters each raise one visible hand above their own shoulder.
Each raised hand can be traced through a plausible connected arm/sleeve to the corresponding voter.
The raised hands are spatially separated enough to count and belong to the same ongoing group decision.
gates.review_scope: Full composition and native-resolution arm/shoulder regions. Skin exposure and every finger are not required; consequential ownership and raised-hand state are.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: One complete raised hand plus a second obscured endpoint, two hands without distinct arm ownership, or hands visible without the relevant shoulders is partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If the necessary arm/hand regions are outside the frame or uninterpretable, mark unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A clearly lowered second arm, detached hand, implausible limb continuity or both raised hands belonging to one actor fails.

gates.label: Chair visibly receives the voters’ answer
gates.ownership: agent-authored carrying relationship in visual priorities 1 and 2
frozen_baseline_evidence: The chair turns toward them with attentive eyes and the beginning of a pleased smile
one forearm resting on the tabletop and her other hand open toward the voters
Her face is seen in three-quarter view
all_required_components: The same reference-informed chair turns her face/attention toward the two voters rather than away from their action.
Her visible face supports an attentive, lightly pleased response at the shutter.
One forearm is naturally supported at the table while her other open hand gestures into the meeting space toward the voters.
gates.review_scope: Judge head direction, eye region, facial affect and broad hand/forearm placement together. Do not invent her internal motive or actual personality from those cues.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: An isolated smile without the directed relationship, a directed head with unassessable face, or an open hand whose owner/target relation is hidden is partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If her face or consequential gesture cannot be observed at usable scale, mark unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A clearly camera-facing posed portrait disconnected from the voters, visible hostility inconsistent with the planned slight pleasure, or contradictory support/contact fails.

gates.label: A separate minute taker records the meeting
gates.ownership: agent-authored supporting relationship in visual priority 4
frozen_baseline_evidence: The minute taker writes in an open notebook
a fourth student of the same age range keeps the minutes on the left
all_required_components: The fourth participant has an open notebook on the shared meeting surface.
Their visible writing action connects a writing tool/hand locally to the notebook page in a plausible posture.
The writer remains a participant in the same visible council gathering.
gates.review_scope: Inspect the actual notebook and writing-hand region after the whole frame. Legible minute text, microscopic pen-nib detail and specific written contents are not required; the macroscopic writing relation must be distinguishable.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: An open book alone, a hand with no visible local relation to the page, or an obscured notebook endpoint is partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If the writer or notebook region is absent from the view or too small to establish any writing relation, use unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A visibly closed notebook, a hand writing on an unrelated surface, or merged writer/voter ownership fails.

gates.label: The central relation coexists in one feasible photograph
gates.ownership: agent-authored presentation and embodiment requirement derived from all four visual priorities
frozen_baseline_evidence: leaving the camera-side edge open
her face and the two raised hands carry the frame
while the notebook and chalkboard remain readable supporting context
Keep the group on a shallow arc at a comparable distance from the lens
all_required_components: The chair’s face, two raised hands, minute taker/notebook and council-classroom context coexist in one image.
The chair and voting hands lead visual attention while the supporting scene remains assessable.
Visible body chains, seating, forearm support and tabletop contacts are mutually plausible with sufficient local space.
gates.review_scope: Full saved image first; crops can verify details but cannot stitch separate frames or repair an absent relation. Ordinary out-of-frame legs need not be exposed solely for review.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: If the image supplies the required elements only in disconnected inserts, montage panels, competing blur planes or occluded fragments, mark partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If overall framing or rendering prevents the whole-scene relation from being judged, use unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: Contradictory support, fused consequential limbs, a hidden voter replaced by a floating hand, or a portrait crop that visibly excludes the meeting fails.

gates.label: School community self-government reads without prompt explanation
gates.ownership: agent-authored whole-image success criterion; separate from user acceptance
frozen_baseline_evidence: A school-life photograph observes students sharing a school day
She presides over a student-council vote
The chair turns toward them with attentive eyes and the beginning of a pleased smile
The minute taker writes in an open notebook
all_required_components: Without reading the prompt, describe a coherent group of students conducting a shared meeting with a show-of-hands decision.
The vote, chair response and record keeping connect causally in the visible scene rather than appearing as unrelated instructions.
The picture remains a believable photographic campus moment with a clear main impression and natural reference-informed lead presence.
gates.review_scope: Write a brief image-first description before comparing individual gates. Judge the frame’s situational clarity, connected responses and hierarchy independently from metadata, exact keyword matches and artistic preference.
gates.pass_rule: All listed components and their consequential connections are visible together in the actual saved image.
gates.partial_rule: If school cues or council text exist but the visible participants do not form an understandable decision, the whole-scene result is partial and FAIL.
gates.unobservable_rule: If the image cannot support an image-first description due to missing or unreadable central content, mark unobservable/BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
gates.visible_fail_rule: A generic beauty portrait, unrelated group pose, disconnected hand demonstration or nonphotographic/surreal staging that defeats the realistic chosen concept fails. Exact unseen backstory is never credited.

supplemental_observations_not_required_g.lighting_and_palette: Describe softness and direction of daylight, neutral shadows and ordinary classroom materials. Do not infer exact time from metadata.
supplemental_observations_not_required_g.wardrobe_and_layout: Report navy/ivory clothing, desk-square geometry, relative left/right placement and horizontal medium-wide framing as baseline fidelity observations; these are not substitutes for the carrying relationships.
supplemental_observations_not_required_g.control_expression: Describe the natural everyday presence and photographic realism first, then compare the intended subtle supporting sensual axis and absence of added fetish/surreal treatment with the frozen resolver; numerical controls are not pixel proof.
supplemental_observations_not_required_g.exact_proposal: The unused-room-to-study-lounge proposal is imagined optional context. A simple sketch cannot prove that specific administrative intent.
supplemental_observations_not_required_g.age_and_identity: The written fictional ages 21 to 24 and actual identity are not visually verifiable facts of the reference. Do not score numeric age accuracy or identity recognition.
